why: Round 2's verdict mixed slices and contradicted the audited training targets. This file fixes the counting unit and the no_change allowance before any re-judgement.

counting.unit: one unit is one contract row; counts are always reported per set and per slice
counting.totals: a cross-set total is allowed only when labelled 'sum of the three sets'
counting.rule: a verdict may not compare a moved-only count on one arm with an all-kind count on another

facts.final: machine S is downgraded to unsupported when the read finds a value token missing; modifiers count as values (e.g. 玻璃 in '玻璃上蒙了盐雾', 缠着 in '缠着的旧缆绳断了')

added.moved: split at the first ，; clause 2 violates when it carries a post-arrival action, a carried object, a body detail or a new entity. Allowed clause 2 = movement only (走到/走进/到了/回到/上到/下到/穿过/一直/沿…) and arrival at a named sub-place
added.noChange: authorised: absence statements, static scene state, ambient activity, and the viewpoint actor waiting or staying (站了一会儿/等了一会儿) without displacement. The audited targets use '他等了一会儿，周围没有新的变化。' for five rows, so waiting is contract-authorised and must not be counted as added. Not authorised: a new named entity, a new object, a world-changing verb, or displacement
added.movedRuleText: clause 2 violates when it is not a movement continuation (走到/走进/到了/回到/上到/下到/穿过/开到/划到/来到/赶到, optionally after 一直/沿着/顺着/从) or when it names a carried object, a body part or an entity outside the visible list
added.knownGap: an in-clause path noun (e.g. 石滩 in 韩渡从潮生巷沿着石滩上到潮渡) is outside both the entity list and the clause-2 check; such rows stay at their recorded judgement and are marked exceptions

repeated: the same proposition stated twice in one sentence
language: malformed wording: double 的, wrong classifier, broken possessive, nonsense collocation

evidence.note: these five rows were rewritten from 场景里 to 周围 by f79261d; the waiting clause itself was kept and is therefore sanctioned
